notes: Seeded per TACR category index i, the same rule baiw.json uses:
current = 1 + 0.5i,  desired = min(5, current + [0.5, 1.2, 1.8, 2.5][i % 4]),
gap = desired - current.
overallScore is src/scoring/maturity.ts::overallCurrent — the mean of the
SCORED categories, one decimal. 22 / 8 = 2.75 -> 2.8.
answeredCategories === totalCategories so isDraft is false.
THE NINTH CATEGORY IS GONE (D4 closing item). This block carried a ninth row,
"Overall Assessment" (5 / 5 / 0), which tacrQuestions.json does not contain and
TradeMaturityAssessment.tsx has never supplied — it builds `categories` from
that dataset and passes `totalCategories: categories.length`, which is 8. So
the baseline described a document production cannot generate, and every TAIW
assertion measured against it — page counts, table rows, right-edge extents,
the D-002 fix, three migration walks — was measured against a shape with one
axis, one scorecard row and three markdown bullets that do not exist.
It also moved the headline: 27 / 9 = 3.0 became 22 / 8 = 2.8, because the
fabricated row was a perfect 5.0 and was averaged in like a real one.
The generator still defines a ninth CATEGORIES entry, and still excludes it
from the deep dives (CATEGORIES.length - 1) and the benchmark table
(CATEGORIES.slice(0, 8)) — that is source, not fixture, and unchanged here.
engagementId/generatedAt/layer were added in D2 step 2, for the same reason
they were added to haiw.json in step 1: the PDF and the markdown now take a
ReportMeta, and a clock-derived date would make them un-reproducible from
one day to the next. The gap CSV reads none of the three - its baseline is
unaffected, and that is checked rather than assumed.
assessmentPartial (D4) — the FIRST artefact in this repo that exercises an
unanswered category. Four of eight TACR categories answered; the fourth
("Information & Integration") only halfway, so the within-category unanswered
path is covered as well as the whole-category one. Derived from the same rule
src/scoring/maturity.ts applies, not hand-typed: overall is the mean of the
SCORED categories' UNROUNDED means. `scores` carries only the scored four —
an unscored category has no number to put on a scorecard row.
Answered 282 of 640 questions;
overall 3 from 4 of 8 categories.
Under the pre-D4 rule (divide by all 8) the same answers put
1.5 on the cover.
dataSources, D5 stage E1. Two directions here, and they are different facts.
capabilities.json and dataRequirements.json ARE imported by
tradeReportGenerator.ts while the `data` block freezes only benchmarks.json,
so both were read LIVE at capture with no fingerprint covering them - D-010,
found by FINGERPRINT-COVERAGE. crosswalk.json is NOT read by a generator
yet; it is declared ahead of D5 stage E3, which puts a framework scorecard
in the report. Declaring first means the fingerprint is correct on the commit
that starts reading it, instead of one stage later - which is exactly how
frameworks.json slipped out from under DGIW's fingerprint in stage B.
Declaring does NOT freeze: only `data` keys are served, so bytes are
unchanged.
